data.short_meaning: Lord of Time or Lord of Fort
data.long_meaning: Khilendra is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from two words: 'Khil' meaning time or fort and 'Endra' meaning lord. The name is believed to represent the lord of time or the lord of fort. It is a powerful name that signifies courage, strength, and valor. The name Khilendra carries the meaning “Lord of Time or Lord of Fort” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Khilendra usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of time or lord of fort and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In India, the name Khilendra is commonly used among the Hindu community and is often found among the noble classes, warriors, and rulers.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Khilendra is believed to resonate with the divine energy of time and protection. It is a name that is believed to invoke the blessings of the celestial beings and the divine beings who hold the reins of time. The name is also believed to protect the individual from the negative effects of time and to help them navigate through the challenges and trials of life. The name is also believed to invoke the blessings of other gods like Shiva, Indra, and Rama, who are known for their strength, courage, and valor.
